prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: side impact at intersection in Pasadena, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1006; do not mention it.)
text: On arrival at the intersection, I observed a two-vehicle collision involving a side impact at the controlled intersection in Pasadena, Texas. Driver 1 was operating a sedan northbound and stated that the traffic signal was green for their direction of travel. Driver 2 was operating an SUV westbound and stated that they entered the intersection after the signal had changed to yellow. The front driver's side of Driver 2's vehicle struck the passenger side of Driver 1's sedan. A Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat of Driver 1's vehicle and reported no visible injuries at the scene. Driver 1 reported pain in the left wrist and was transported by EMS for evaluation. Both vehicles sustained heavy damage and were towed from the roadway. Skid marks were observed from Driver 2's vehicle leading into the intersection. Weather was clear and the roadway was dry. Citations are pending completion of the investigation.
